content.text: W’ono nyâkîreko Nyamwagirwa, Orhazigaga enshonyi zambumba ciru n’olusiku luguma
Omu bushinganyanya bwâwe ondîkûze onancize, oyuname ontege okurhwiri onandîkûze.
Ombêre ibuye nyâkiraho, onshubire côgo cizibu lyo ndobôka.
Yâgirwa Nnâmahanga, nkûla omu maboko g’eyi nkola-maligo, ntenza omu nfune z’oyu mumînya w’ecishungu.
We nâlolakwo, Yâgirwa Nnâmahanga, we nyôrha ncîkubagira kurhenga oburhò bwâni.
We nyegemera kurhenga okuburhwa kwâni, we mufungizi wâni kurhenga omu nda ya nyâmà, we nancîkubagira ensiku zoshi.
Omu masù ga banji kwo nabîre nka cisômerîne, bulyâla wakaz’intabâla buzibu.
Akanwa kâni karhadwîrhi kahusa kuyimba irenge lyâwe, budwîrhe bwaca bunayîre erhi irenge lyâwe kayimba.
Orhanjahikaga amango nkola ndi mushosi, orhandekêreraga amango ntacigwêrhi magala.
Bulyâla abashombanyi bâni nie badwîrhe baderha, abadwîrhe bambona mahwe badwîrhe bahekana, mpu:
«Nyamuzinda amulekêrîre», mpu: «Mukanye mumugwârhe bulya arhagwêrhi cafungira.»
Mâshi Nnâmahanga orhanjâga kuli mâshi, okanye ontabâle, Waliha Nnâmahanga.
Ngasi bashimbire omûka gwâni, enshonyi zibagwarhe babulabule; balya barhammirira marhî boshi, enshonyi zibayûbikire, zibabumbe.
Niehe we nyôrha ncîkubagira, n’irenge lyâwe lyo nakaz’ilwîra.
Akanwa kâni kacîtakîre obushinganyanya bwâwe, kalegerere kayigâna oku burhabâle bwâwe: ntânaderhe nti lwo lugero nalekerakw’olu.
Naderha ebijiro by’obuhashe bwâwe, Nnâmahanga, nnanyimbe obushinganyanya bwâwe Nyamwagirwa.
Wanyigîrizagya nciri murhò, Yâgirwa Nyamuzinda, na kuhika buno ebisômerîne byâwe kuderha mbiderha.
Bukolaga bushosi obu, zikola mvi zino, Yâgirwa Nnâmahanga orhandekêreraga; nkaziganîrira abâna ba buno emisî y’okuboko kwâwe, n’abâna bâburhwa boshi mbabwîre obuhashe bwâwe?
Mbabwîre obushinganyanya bwâwe buhumire oku nkuba Yâgirwa Nnâmahanga, bulya wajiragamwo ebingan’aha; Nyamuzinda mushâna orhajîbwa omu irhwe!
We wanyêrekaga amalibuko ntya, we wananshubizamwo omûka, we wanashubindengeza onkûle omûla kuzimu.
Obukulu bwâni buhirekwo obundi, onashubintûliriza.
Nâni nkolaga nayimba oburhabêsha bwâwe oku mulya gw’olulanga, nkukuze n’enzenze, we Mwimâma w’Israheli.
Kucîshinga akanwa kâni kâcîshinga hano nkola nakuyimbira, omurhima gwâni wâcungula gwohe kusîmîriza gwâsimiriza.
Olulimi lundi ekanwa nalwo lurhahuse lwaganîra obushinganyanya bwâwe, obûla balya barhannongezagya kalamo wababonesize nshonyi.
